name: navi-raycast
title: Navi
description: Ask navi from Raycast. Uses the same models as navi: one on this computer, or a provider or endpoint chosen in Set Up Navi.
author: jeanno

commands.name: ask-ai
commands.title: Ask Navi
commands.description: Ask a one-off question and get a streamed answer.

commands.name: ask-files
commands.title: Ask About Selected Files
commands.description: Ask about the files selected in Finder: images, PDFs or text.

commands.name: fix-grammar
commands.title: Fix Spelling and Grammar
commands.description: Correct the spelling and grammar of the selected text and replace it.

commands.name: translate-replace
commands.title: Translate and Replace
commands.description: Translate the selected text into your chosen language and replace it.

commands.name: summarize
commands.title: Summarize
commands.description: Summarize the selected text, or the clipboard if nothing is selected.

commands.name: set-up-navi
commands.title: Set Up Navi
commands.description: Choose the models navi answers with: on this computer, a provider, or your own endpoint.

preferences.name: showReasoning
preferences.title: Reasoning
preferences.label: Show the model's reasoning
preferences.description: Show <think>…</think> output above the answer instead of hiding it.

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Translate To
preferences.description: The language Translate and Replace translates into.
